about: The Vale Museum (build2): a building placed through layout data, a row of the kind `museum` (src/app/94-garden-zz-7act-0kinds.js), painted by 'vale-museum' (src/app/94-garden-native-painted-zb2museum.js). Its door opens the one collection every museum shares (src/app/94-garden-build2-3museum.js). Placed against the garden shop, so it stays at the west end of the village if the layout moves the shop; the game's ground rule keeps its whole footprint off paths, plots, paving and water, and moves it to the nearest clear ground within 3 cells (check with node tools/affordance-audit.mjs). Not part of the saved-world identity.

things.name: The Vale Museum
things.note: on the open grass at the west end of the village, south of where the plaza road ends: its door faces south, a forecourt of flags in front
